Target: Doc Index, show Title; INDEXED — create via CLASSIC list settings (modern-created lookups are broken: silent write drops, spinning pickers)

{DocRowId}|{ordinal} — INDEXED; the replace-set diff key (Figure_Index_Plan.md, the Case_Index_Plan D4 rule): every (re)index of a document replaces its full figure-row set, so this is a within-run dedup key, never a durable figure identity
0 decimals; the figure's ordinal in document order (images and diagrams share one sequence); display only, never identity

image; diagram; icon; drawing — image = a pasted picture extracted into media/<stem>/ (has a file, a link and a size); diagram = a drawn diagram ZipTextExtract collapsed into one '[figure: …]' label line (no file — the labels are the Caption); icon = a picture no larger than 48 px on its longest side (button glyphs from docx documentation pages — figureindex v1.1; still a named file with a link and size, set aside from the figures proper); drawing = the slide's drawn shapes and text rendered faithfully to an SVG file by ShapeExtract (figureindex v1.2 / sweep v1.61) — when the slide's short labels also collapsed into a '[figure: …]' line, the two fold into this ONE row (file from the drawing, Caption from the labels)

The standardized media file name 'fig-NN[-slide-KK][-<slug>].<ext>' (figureindex v1.0 — NN = ordinal, KK = first slide, slug = slide title / nearest docx heading, or since v1.1 an untitled slide's first text line; jpeg → jpg); a legacy 'image1.png' until --reformat renames the corpus; empty for diagrams
png; jpg; gif; bmp; svg; other; none — from the file extension; none for diagrams; svg = a rendered drawing (Kind drawing)
0 decimals; the slide the figure sits on ('## Slide N' heading or the section heading's slide comment); empty for docx-derived figures

The TC id ('TC-P04') when the figure sits inside a test-case section of the testplan/v1 grammar; empty otherwise — joins to the Test Cases row by CaseNo + Document
GitHub-style anchor slug of the section heading — deep link target {TextFileUrl}#{Anchor}

Diagrams and drawings: the collapsed label text ('10–22 · R1 · E1 · Output'), or a label-less drawing's '[connections: …]' text; images: a meaningful alt text when the source carried one (the generated 'Figure N — …' alt and the file name do not count); capped 255
PLAIN text (not enhanced); the prose of the figure's section with tables/figure links/fences stripped, capped by sweep.figureIndex.contextCap (2000) — skim/search aid, like CaseText
0 decimals; pixel width from the file header (PNG/GIF/BMP/JPEG, or an SVG drawing's own width) when the file is on disk at index time; empty otherwise
0 decimals; pixel height, as Width
0 decimals; file size on disk; empty for diagrams or a file not on disk
